title: Answer: no account of measurement, and collapse accounts are left open

statements.text: The theorem takes no position on measurement or on the quantum measurement problem. It holds for quantum theories insofar as they supply a dynamically sufficient local state, and it leaves open accounts that tie consciousness to a present quantum state or to collapse, which are not excluded merely because they invoke change or an instantaneous event.
statements.scope: the no-go theorem, version 1 of the preprint

sources.quote: It applies to any other physical theory, including quantum theories, insofar as that theory supplies an analogous dynamically sufficient local state.
Such accounts are not excluded merely because they invoke change or an instantaneous event.
